name: What Jesus Wore
overview: Scripture reveals meaningful details about what Jesus wore, reflecting both Old Testament customs and the significance of His earthly ministry. Numbers 15:38 instructs the Israelites to make fringes on their garments as a sign of obedience and remembrance, a practice rooted in God's covenant. Matthew 3:11 highlights John the Baptist's humility, declaring he is unworthy to carry Jesus' shoes, emphasizing the honor and authority associated with even the simplest items of clothing. Finally, John 19:23 describes the soldiers dividing Jesus' seamless coat after His crucifixion, underscoring the fulfillment of prophecy and the unity symbolized by this garment woven without seam.
